reviewMethod: All 112 full-resolution screenshots were inspected in 28 four-frame review batches. After the responsive source fixes, all six affected recipes were recaptured and re-inspected at desktop, tablet, 390px mobile, and 320px mobile; the final 320 contact sheet was also inspected across all 28 recipes.

tintVerdict.notes: Canvases and broad glass surfaces remain neutral. Localized semantic status accents and chart marks are intentional; no pale-blue, cyan, mint, purple, amber, or navy cast blankets a canvas or large material surface.

mobile320.notes: All six previously confirmed 320px defects are visibly resolved. Long recipes correctly scroll vertically. Raw root scrollWidth and zero-size descendant heuristics in 320-capture-summary.json are non-document-overflow layout artifacts; no frame has document-level horizontal overflow, hidden primary content, or destructive clipping.
